notes:
The app now listens to your source audio in the background. Preflight points out:
- distortion in the original recordings, with timecode and a "Show on timeline" marker
- silent channels (dead mic, unused input), with a fix to leave them out
- duplicate channels and -10 dB safety copies, with a fix to leave them out
Hot 32-bit float recordings are kept undistorted in the AAF automatically.
